name: Omar
notes: Eats halal only: no pork or pork products (gelatin, lard, bacon), no alcohol in cooking, and meat should be halal. Lactose intolerant, so avoid milk, cream and soft cheeses; dairy-free swaps are fine. Keeps weeknights simple but loves long braises and big spreads on weekends, often for 6-8 guests, so weekend recipes can be scaled up.
